issues.desc: background.md Key Insights and index.json description both state the root test script is only `npm run test:e2e`, but the actual package.json test script chains 8 commands (test:main-write-lock-coverage, test:koala-residue, test:review-convergence-smoke, test:review-incremental-context-smoke, test:docs-drift-smoke, test:docs-drift-wrapper-root, test:gitroot-cwd-contract, test:e2e). This incorrect baseline may mislead the implementer about the starting point for CHK-001.

description references test:storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke and test:storydir-inside-gitroot-suite as orphaned smokes to aggregate, but neither exists as an npm script entry in package.json (only as compiled dist/ task files). Similarly test:evidence-state-gate-smoke and test:authority-gate-* do not appear in package.json scripts. The implementer will need to create these script entries or adjust scope before wiring.

test:gitroot-cwd-contract is already present in the root test script (package.json line 15), but background.md and description list the wrapper-root/gitRoot smokes as uniformly invisible to validate. This inconsistency could cause CHK-002 verification to pass prematurely or double-count an existing entry.

CHK-001 and CHK-002 userSees overlap: both mention deliberately-broken smoke turning validate red. Consider sharpening CHK-001 userSees to focus on smoke output appearing in the validate run, and CHK-002 userSees to focus on the red/green proof. Advisory only -- does not block.
